patch_description: Replace the Python linear scan over every non-full pack with a min-heap. The previous LPT-style assignment selected the least-loaded eligible pack in O(num_packs) time per group, while a heap performs the identical selection in O(log(num_packs)). Converting sorted indices and row weights to Python lists also avoids repeated CPU tensor scalar extraction and tensor arithmetic inside the innermost loop. This preserves the balanced-packing policy while substantially reducing rearrangement overhead for many groups, nodes, or GPUs.
